name: Speed Draw!
desc:
Like pixel art? Play Pixel Art Creator!  https://www.roblox.com/games/90660715/Draw-Pixel-Art-Creator

UPDATE: 5 Minutes Mode & PRO Mode, Free Coins Machine, Effects & Pets Stay on Podiums, 10 New Drawing Themes & Rainbow Palette!

👍 BIG UPDATE AT 500,,000 LIKES 👍

 The competitive drawing game with a fun, multiplayer twist. The clock is ticking, and it's time to Speed Draw! Challenge your friends to make the coolest artwork! Become a pro artist! Follow and ⭐ the game to be notified of updates! 

Please send all bugs and suggestions to us by posting on the group wall! 

Drawing Controls: - Zoom: use mouse wheel / pinch screen without a tool selected to zoom in your camera - Pan: click/touch and drag without a tool selected to move your camera - 1, 2, 3: equip/unequip tools 

❗FREE Custom Themes now available in Private Servers! 

Special thanks to zuffhy!
